spans.s: अद्भुत (I) a. (f. ता) Supernatural, wonderful, marvellous.
अद्भुत (II) m. The marvellous, considered as one of the eight or nine Rasas (in rhetoric). See under रस.
अद्भुत (III) n. 1. Surprise, astonishment; 2. a prodigy.
अद्भुत (I) a. (f. ता) Supernatural, wonderful, marvellous.
अद्भुत-स्वन m. a name of Śiva.
